title: Wildlife Documentary Storytelling: 3 Shots, One Clear Story
description:
Turn wildlife clips into a clear story: choose one animal behaviour, build a hook, and use only footage you have permission to publish. The three visual examples in this review are separate Pexels clips, not one continuous encounter. In your own film, keep related shots from one real encounter in sequence.
